the_axis_map.dump_law: on 16/09 the cert set alone discriminates stock-3644 from flashed-3645 (alongside the PSP set, and count-blind-proof), and the DSDT set alone certifies the board identity
the_axis_map.law: certs is a RELEASE marker (3644->3645 rotates exactly one certificate 2da09da7f4131f9f -> 4aa03fa22cd75c84 inside a stable count of 6; 3802->3810 rebuilds the trust store 4->6 — the corpus's freeze point, pair-explained); dsdt is a BOARD marker (the same-version sibling swaps ALL FOUR variants, zero overlap, at stable count 4; releases keep the DSDT set identical on BOTH families); whitelist, smm and agesa moved on NO measured pair
the_axis_map.orthogonality: a release touches the trust store and not the ACPI lineage; a board change touches the ACPI lineage and not the trust store — the two event types have orthogonal axis signatures
